evals.prompt: Add a 'Product Interest' Multi Select field to CRM Lead and make it visible in the lead's side panel. The field should be filterable from the lead list view. Do this without modifying the crm app's Vue source files.
evals.expected_output: Steps to add a Custom Field to CRM Lead, configure the side panel via the CRM Settings or JSON config, and add the field as a filterable column — all without editing Vue source
expectations: Confirms the crm app (Frappe CRM) is installed, distinct from checking for ERPNext
Adds the field as a Custom Field on 'CRM Lead' using Customize Form or a fixture, not by editing crm app source DocType JSON
Shows how to expose the field in the side panel using CRM's side panel configuration (CRM Fields Layout or equivalent settings DocType), not by editing .vue files
Does not instruct editing any file inside the crm app's src/ directory

evals.prompt: Configure an SLA on CRM Deal so that deals in the 'Qualified' stage must be moved forward within 3 business days. The timer should pause when the deal is waiting for a customer response and fire a notification when breached.
evals.expected_output: Steps to create an SLA record scoped to CRM Deal, define the pause condition, set the breach action, and verify the timer is attached
expectations: Creates an SLA record targeting the 'CRM Deal' DocType with the correct response/resolution time fields
Identifies the pause condition mechanism available in Frappe CRM (e.g., a status-based pause or the 'Customer Reply' trigger)
Sets the breach action as a notification (email or system notification) rather than hardcoding a frappe.sendmail call
Describes how to verify the SLA is attached by opening a Deal in the Qualified stage and checking the SLA section
